items.title: Mid-term facts & refrigerator hacks, tech sell-off continues, Binance CEO addresses issues
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the top stories of the trading day, including the reasons Palantir (PLTR) isn't escaping the AI rout, why Disney (DIS) is poised to cut jobs, and how Apple's (AAPL) earnings just turned into a dull day for John Ternus and company.

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Binance (BNB-USD) CEO and Founder, Changpeng Zhao, to examine the roughly $6.3 billion worth of digital assets drained from Binance on Oct. 29 due to a hack.

items.title: Stocks continue sell-off as AI worries mount, Wall Street braces for midterms, Palantir outlook
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Pras Subramanian, Jake Conley, and Sherwood News Head of Markets Luke Kawa tackle the day's top stories, including Palantir's (PLTR) outlook signaling a slowdown in AI-fueled sales growth, Disney (DIS) looking to cut jobs in a cost-saving push, and how Wall St. is bracing for changes in Congress from the midterms.

items.title: Palantir grew Q3 revenue by 96% — so why is its stock falling now?
items.summary:
Palantir Technologies (PLTR) may have outpaced third quarter estimates — growing revenue by 96% year-over-year — but its stock is now falling in Tuesday's pre-market session.

Sherwood News head of markets Luke Kawa joins The 8:30 team to take a closer look at the post-earning stock reaction.

items.title: Palantir (PLTR) Stock Cools As Q3 Earnings Showcase Huge Margins
items.summary: Palantir Technologies just printed its Q3 2026 scorecard and the headline is simple. Revenue crossed US$2.3b and net income hit roughly US$1.1b, yet the stock slipped about 1.7% today to around US$175.40. That gap between a cooling share price and powerful profit delivery is the whole story. The real fulcrum for this quarter is profitability. GAAP operating margin landed close to the high 40s while adjusted operating margin reached the low 60s. Traders focused on a richly valued, volatile AI...
